criteria.intent: Preserve the approved plan, linked separate Draft PR and nonblocking ownership relation to article PR79.
criteria.automated_scope: Planning checkpoint only: existing checks verify source hygiene, style and navigation/CI consistency. They do not test campaign behavior or establish that this criterion is implemented. Before campaign implementation add meaningful behavioral assertions described in the versioned plan and revise this scope.

criteria.intent: Integrate a reusable distribution brief and campaign state model into article preparation without duplicating owners.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing draft workflow plus an explicit exact-SHA clean publisher-checkout bridge for draft preparation before main integration. Default route still requires the canonical publisher; no publisher/manuscript/media copy.

criteria.intent: Bind each campaign piece to its source edition, claims and media and invalidate stale approvals.
criteria.automated_scope: Edition/semantic/section/reference/media/caption/frame-script and approval invalidation; exact clean provider identity and consumed inputs rechecked before installation. Accuracy and actual editorial review remain human gates.

criteria.intent: Prepare the complete six-piece, three-carousel organic PMDay campaign for author review.
criteria.automated_scope: First launch and delivery-constraint carousel kit only. Source cases and actual all-frame/mobile visual inspection are separate; remaining four feed pieces/two carousels and whole editorial acceptance stay pending.

criteria.intent: Preserve numerical and quotation scope, media identity, credits and separate editorial/rights review.
criteria.automated_scope: Selected source/media/frame identity, exact credits and source-map review. Synthetic weekly capacity conditions, quotation boundaries and actual mobile/rights acceptance remain explicit human review.

criteria.intent: Require actual destinations and channel admission for release-ready output; allow explicit skipped channels.
criteria.automated_scope: Draft-only actual-or-pending canonical; no fabricated publication, D0 or channel permission. Real release-ready admission remains pending.

criteria.intent: Build a bounded isolated campaign kit without site deployment, social posting, paid-model calls or PMDay-only hardcoding.
criteria.automated_scope: Bounded isolated article and event draft kit production through shared cards. Two synthetic articles, equal page geometry/overflow, stale input/media/provider, no-overwrite and public-isolation negatives. Actual browser rendering/source proof and manual workflow are recorded separately.

criteria.intent: Keep authored, approved, published and corrected states distinct with actual observed publication evidence.
criteria.automated_scope: First increment: authored and approval-recorded draft states only; pretend publication fields are rejected. Observations, append-only correction history and operator publication workflow remain pending.

criteria.intent: Provide honest aggregate D+7/D+21 reviews without private data, invented feedback or unsupported attribution.
criteria.automated_scope: Reusable manual D+7/D+21 aggregate templates with unknown data and equal-age/source limitations; no automatic attribution, private correspondence or invented results.

criteria.intent: Map and run exact-source meaningful checks and applicable style/RI controls; retain human and merge gates.
criteria.automated_scope: Basic, style subset, RI/catalog/CI and campaign negatives on exact source. Applicable CS01-CS10 self-review is recorded: canonical offline CSS reuse and no runtime delta. Browser diagnostics and independent/editorial/merge gates remain distinct.

criteria.intent: Render only selected source/review-bound public materials, preserve reciprocal article links and exclude working campaign inputs.
criteria.automated_scope: Strict source/file/approval/URL/resource/dependency behavior and shared HTML tested with maintained fixtures. Actual reader integration, mobile/no-JS and author/rights/release acceptance are recorded separately.

criteria.intent: Support confirmed event sources and typed observed destinations without an article.
criteria.automated_scope: Two distinct event fixtures, absent publisher, pending session/deck, invalid and unobserved CTA/source inputs.

criteria.intent: Resolve before/after and exact local dates with IANA zones and feasible dependencies.
criteria.automated_scope: Actual summer/winter conversions, invalid dates, DST gaps/ambiguity, graph cycles and transitive impossible windows.

criteria.intent: Render three reusable promotion layouts and preserve selected source-deck page identity and credit.
criteria.automated_scope: Shared source-pinned promotion templates consume canonical site theme/font declarations. PDF/media negatives and actual all-frame visual/overflow observations remain distinct from author/rights acceptance.

criteria.intent: Allow English and Ukrainian pieces in one event campaign.
criteria.automated_scope: Two distinct event fixtures contain independently owned English copy and planned Ukrainian pieces; schema and copy-owner constraints reject undeclared language.

criteria.intent: Produce isolated reviewable kits and stable private calendar-file exports.
criteria.automated_scope: Copy-only transactional kit/manifest/source/public isolation and overwrite negatives; stable UID, revision sequence, UTC times and UTF8 folding. Actual render reviewed separately; no publication observation support is claimed.

criteria.intent: Maintain compatible article checks and source/RI/style routes with truthful acceptance.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing article and event source suites, Basic, style subset and RI/CI/profile checks. Independent/author/merge and actual publisher-related original gates remain open.

PLAN-REVIEW.description: Verify the actual linked issue/PR and versioned approved scope, source reference, relative schedule and explicit nonblocking separation from PR79. This is plan review, not campaign implementation.

IMPLEMENTATION.description: Draft article/event kits, first authored launch/carousel and manual aggregate templates are implemented in bounded scope. Main publisher-flow integration, remaining four feed pieces/two carousels, channel admission, D0/release-ready validation and observed publication/correction history remain unfinished. Partial checks cannot satisfy whole acceptance.

AUTHOR-REVIEW.description: Review actual content/media, source accuracy, channel rules and manual publishing/measurement operation. Actual public URLs and channel admission must be observed separately; no private data or auto-posting.

INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.description: Required independent/editorial review of implemented behavior and applicable CS01-CS10; preparation self-review is not independent acceptance.

MERGE.description: Normal maintainer merge decision after complete issue acceptance; campaign readiness cannot block the separate article publication in PR79.
